title.narrative: 224104_START FUND - ALERT 924 Uganda (Cross-border displacement due to conflict)

description.narrative:
The project will implement a comprehensive set of interventions to address the diverse needs of the affected population, as outlined below;
WASH (Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene): The project will provide a combination of in-kind support to address both household and individual WASH needs. This includes the provision of education sessions aimed at improving hygiene behaviors among new arrivals. Additionally, the project will enhance the reception's capacity to offer adequate WASH services by installing water access points and distributing essential cleaning materials. These measures will ensure that new arrivals are welcomed with dignity and provided with necessary hygiene resources.
Non-Food Items (NFIs): The project will distribute essential Non-Food Items, such as cooking utensils, blankets, and other household necessities, to help families meet their basic needs. This distribution will support households in settling and adapting to their new environment. Special attention will be given to women and girls of reproductive age, who will receive Menstrual Management Hygiene (MHM) kits to address menstrual hygiene needs.
Mental Health and Protection, including GBV: To help individuals and households cope with the emotional and psychological stress experienced during displacement, the project will provide basic psychological support services (PSS). This will include play therapy for children and basic counseling for adults. Additionally, community volunteers will be trained and supported to provide ongoing PSS services to new arrivals, ensuring that they receive the necessary support to manage mental distress.
Food Security and Nutrition: The project will offer Multipurpose Cash Assistance (MPCA) to households to address their food and nutrition needs. Cash transfers will be provided to the head of each household, identified through the camp registration records and validated through community meetings. This support will help families meet their basic food requirements and improve their overall nutritional status.
